Project Title & File

Project Title: ai-ml-ds-zYxQpA9tUBF – Conditional Classifier-Free Guided DDPM on MNIST
File Name: conditional_cfddpm_mnist.py

Short Description

Train a conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) on MNIST using classifier-free guidance. This marks a leap in complexity: timestep & class conditioning, guided sampling mixing conditional/unconditional predictions, UNet backbone, and high-performance diffusion scheduler.

Full Python Code

# conditional_cfddpm_mnist.py
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds
from typing import Tuple

# --- Helper types
x_img: tf.Tensor
timestep: tf.Tensor
class_label: tf.Tensor

# --- Hyperparameters
img_size: Tuple[int,int] = (28,28)
batch_size: int = 128
num_classes: int = 10
T: int = 200                  # diffusion steps
beta_start: float = 1e-4
beta_end: float = 0.02
guidance_scale: float = 3.0   # CFG weight
p_uncond: float = 0.1         # null conditioning

# --- Diffusion schedule
beta: tf.Tensor = tf.linspace(beta_start, beta_end, T)
alpha: tf.Tensor = 1.0 - beta
alpha_bar: tf.Tensor = tf.math.cumprod(alpha)

def sample_q(x0: tf.Tensor, t: tf.Tensor, noise: tf.Tensor):
    """ Sample forward noised x_t """
    # sqrt(alpha_bar[t])*x0 + sqrt(1-alpha_bar[t])*noise
    return (tf.gather(tf.sqrt(alpha_bar), t)[:,None,None,None] * x0 + 
            tf.gather(tf.sqrt(1-alpha_bar), t)[:,None,None,None] * noise)

# --- UNet backbone with class & time embeddings
def build_unet():
    in_img = layers.Input(shape=(*img_size,1), name='x_input')
    in_t = layers.Input(shape=(), dtype=tf.int32, name='t_input')
    in_c = layers.Input(shape=(), dtype=tf.int32, name='c_input')
    # embeddings
    t_emb = layers.Embedding(T, 32)(in_t)
    c_emb = layers.Embedding(num_classes, 32)(in_c)
    cond = layers.Add()([t_emb, c_emb])
    cond_fc = layers.Dense(img_size[0]*img_size[1], activation='swish')(cond)
    cond_resh = layers.Reshape((*img_size,1))(cond_fc)
    x = layers.Concatenate()([in_img, cond_resh])
    # conv layers
    x = layers.Conv2D(64,3,padding='same',activation='swish')(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(64,3,padding='same',activation='swish')(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(1,1,padding='same')(x)
    return Model([in_img,in_t,in_c], x, name='unet')

model: Model = build_unet()
opt = keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=2e-4)

# --- Data
ds, info = tfds.load('mnist', split='train', with_info=True)
def preprocess(d):
    x = tf.cast(d['image'], tf.float32)/127.5 - 1.0
    y = d['label']
    return x, y
ds = ds.map(preprocess).shuffle(10_000).batch(batch_size).prefetch(2)

# --- Loss step
@tf.function
def train_step(x0, y):
    batch = tf.shape(x0)[0]
    t = tf.random.uniform([batch],0,T, dtype=tf.int32)
    noise = tf.random.normal(tf.shape(x0))
    xt = sample_q(x0, t, noise)
    # classifier-free conditioning
    mask = tf.random.uniform([batch]) < p_uncond
    yc = tf.where(mask, tf.zeros_like(y), y)
    pred = model([xt, t, yc], training=True)
    loss = tf.reduce_mean((noise - pred)**2)
    grads = tf.gradients(loss, model.trainable_weights)
    opt.apply_gradients(zip(grads, model.trainable_weights))
    return loss

# --- Sampling
@tf.function
def sample(n: int, trg_c: tf.Tensor):
    x = tf.random.normal((n,*img_size,1))
    for t in tf.range(T-1, -1, -1):
        tt = tf.fill([n], t)
        c_un = tf.zeros_like(trg_c)
        eps_cond = model([x, tt, trg_c], training=False)
        eps_uncond = model([x, tt, c_un], training=False)
        eps = (1+guidance_scale)*eps_cond - guidance_scale*eps_uncond
        alpha_t = alpha[t]; alpha_bar_t = alpha_bar[t]
        beta_t = beta[t]
        pred_x0 = (x - tf.sqrt(1-alpha_bar_t)*eps)/tf.sqrt(alpha_bar_t)
        coef = beta_t / tf.sqrt(1-alpha_bar_t)
        mean = tf.sqrt(alpha_t)*(x - coef*eps)
        if t > 0:
            noise = tf.random.normal(tf.shape(x))
            x = mean + tf.sqrt(beta_t)*noise
        else:
            x = mean
    return pred_x0

# --- Training loop
for epoch in range(30):
    for x0,y in ds:
        loss = train_step(x0, y)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch}: loss={loss.numpy():.4f}")
    # sample output
    test_c = tf.constant([epoch % num_classes]*16)
    imgs = sample(16, test_c).numpy()
    # visualize or save...

Example Use Cases

  1. Unconditional sampling: pass trg_c=tf.zeros([16]) → random MNIST digits.
  2. Class-conditioned: trg_c=tf.constant([3]*16) → generate only digit “3”.
  3. Adjusting guidance_scale: higher for fidelity, lower for diversity.

Key Learnings

  • Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG): combine conditional + unconditional noise estimates from same UNet (github.com, keras.io, tree.rocks, tsgm.readthedocs.io, betterprogramming.pub, medium.com, en.wikipedia.org, medium.com, arxiv.org).
  • UNet + timestep + class embeddings: advanced architecture.
  • Forward (q) & reverse (p) diffusion process.
  • Loss: MSE between predicted and actual noise.
  • Diffusion scheduling: linear beta schedule.
  • Trade-offs: control sample quality via guidance_scale.
  • Research Areas: diffusion models, CFG, generative modeling, UNet in diffusion; googleable terms: classifier_free_guidance keras, conditional_ddpm Unet mnist.
